addons.name: Echo
addons.description: Echoes any payload it receives, prefixed with 'echo:'.

findings.summary: Reviewed against ADR-0006 (sandbox/CSP), ADR-0008 (manifest signing), and ADR-0011 (forbidden APIs). Reference echo bridge demo, no host-side state.

addons.name: Whiteboard
addons.description: Shared whiteboard. Strokes flow P2P; the canvas snapshot is local-first.

findings.summary: Reviewed against ADR-0006 (sandbox/CSP), ADR-0008 (manifest signing), and ADR-0011 (forbidden APIs). No findings outside the bridge contract.

addons.name: Avatar Presence
addons.description: Lightweight presence (speaking, emotion, reactions). No video — state only.

findings.summary: Reviewed against ADR-0006 (sandbox/CSP), ADR-0008 (manifest signing), and ADR-0011 (forbidden APIs). Confirmed no media tracks are requested — presence is state-only.

addons.name: Local Vault
addons.description: Stores user-selected files locally and ships them P2P (≤ 4 MiB chunked) to the connected peer.

findings.summary: Reviewed against ADR-0006 (sandbox/CSP), ADR-0008 (manifest signing), ADR-0011 (forbidden APIs), and ADR-0012 (chunked binary peer transfer). Files stay local until the user opts to send.

addons.name: Voice Meter
addons.description: Visualises microphone-derived audio level via the audio.level bridge — no raw audio is exposed to the add-on.

findings.summary: Reviewed against ADR-0006 (sandbox/CSP), ADR-0008 (manifest signing), ADR-0011 (forbidden APIs), and ADR-0015 (media tracks). Add-on only consumes audio.level; raw audio stays host-side.

addons.name: Voice Call
addons.description: Reference 1:1 voice call. Asks the host to send mic + receive remote audio via the media.* bridge; the addon never sees raw audio (ADR-0015).

findings.summary: Reviewed against ADR-0006 (sandbox/CSP), ADR-0008 (manifest signing), ADR-0011 (forbidden APIs), and ADR-0015 (media tracks). Add-on issues media.* bridge calls only; host owns the audio track end-to-end.

addons.name: Minimal Add-on
addons.description: Smallest possible SENN add-on, used as a template and for runtime tests.

findings.summary: Reviewed against ADR-0006 (sandbox/CSP), ADR-0008 (manifest signing), and ADR-0011 (forbidden APIs). Minimal template; no bridge calls beyond runtime handshake.
